Details.title: Details
Details.description:
The full usage-and-cost payload as a JSON string, formatted EXACTLY like this:

{"title":"Your energy this cycle","cycleText":"Sep 1–30 · 8 days left","projectedCost":142.50,"currency":"USD","projectedText":"Projected bill","usedUnits":612,"unit":"kWh","deltaPct":-8,"deltaText":"less than last month","bars":[{"label":"Wk1","value":158},{"label":"Wk2","value":171},{"label":"Wk3","value":149},{"label":"Wk4","value":134}],"breakdown":[{"label":"Heating & cooling","amount":74.20,"color":"#d97706"},{"label":"Water heating","amount":31.00},{"label":"Always-on","amount":22.40},{"label":"Other","amount":14.90}],"submitText":"See ways to save","submitValue":"Show me ways to lower my energy bill"}

Rules:
- 'title' (string, optional): heading. Defaults to 'Your energy this cycle'.
- 'cycleText' (string, optional): billing-cycle status line, e.g. 'Sep 1–30 · 8 days left'.
- 'projectedCost' (number, optional): the projected bill amount; rendered large.
- 'currency' (string, optional): ISO code, default USD.
- 'projectedText' (string, optional): label above the projected cost, default 'Projected bill'.
- 'usedUnits' (number, optional): energy consumed this cycle.
- 'unit' (string, optional): unit of measure, default 'kWh'.
- 'deltaPct' (number, optional): change vs last month as a percent — negative renders green ('down/less'), positive amber ('up/more').
- 'deltaText' (string, optional): trailing words after the delta, e.g. 'less than last month'.
- 'bars' (array, optional): usage columns, each { 'label' (string), 'value' (number) }. Rendered as a vertical bar chart (2–8 bars). Omit to hide the chart.
- 'breakdown' (array, optional): cost drivers, each { 'label' (string, REQUIRED), 'amount' (number, REQUIRED), 'color' (optional hex) }. Rendered as a segmented meter + legend; colors auto-assign from a palette when absent.
- 'submitText' (string, optional): action-button label, e.g. 'See ways to save'. Omit for no button.
- 'submitValue' (string, optional): the message sent back when the button is tapped; defaults to the label.

Use these EXACT field names — they are the single contract the card reads.
